summary: A treasurer explains what members gain and lose by getting a report early.
realLife: When Maines asked for advance figures, Camilla Hicks agreed to circulate them the Tuesday before the meeting and explained that she normally waited for the last statements.
inGame: needs: the requested circulation date and the dates the statements arrive.

turns.what: The treasurer sends members the reconciled figures.
turns.pulledBy: The bank statement arrives before the agreed mailing.
turns.writesBack: Members receive a dated report before they meet.

turns.what: The treasurer explains the difference at the meeting.
turns.pulledBy: A statement arrives after the report went out.
turns.writesBack: The correction is attached to the advance copy.
